source.name: AppShell uses observer measurements without forcing workspace layout during mount

native.rationale: Native layout consumes the current egui client rectangle directly, so browser ResizeObserver and fallback rAF callbacks are removed rather than emulated. entries.id: src/components/TemplateEditorWindow.test.ts#TemplateEditorWindow consumes repeated Save and Save As keys while the first editor save awaits acknowledgement#1

source.name: TemplateEditorWindow consumes repeated Save and Save As keys while the first editor save awaits acknowledgement

native.rationale: An actual pending Save As picker owns the busy state. All four Load/Unload/Save/Save As buttons expose disabled accessibility states; repeated Save and conflicting Load/Unload/Apply/Close keys cannot create a second picker, close, or mutate the focused name. Cancel releases busy without writing disk. Native exact blocked chords are consumed to avoid egui's Ctrl+U delete-line fallback; the source browser's pending-action fallback is inert rather than a native text deletion, so this adapter distinction preserves user-visible behavior and command availability.

entries.id: src/composables/useHotkeys.test.ts#useHotkeys consumes a disabled app shortcut without invoking it#1

source.name: useHotkeys consumes a disabled app shortcut without invoking it

native.rationale: Reviewed both duplicated source F3 identities, including Shift+F3, plus all disabled/reserved Save cases. Native frames assert the actual Key event is consumed before another widget can see it, with no picker, file, error or navigation-bar mutation. There is no browser save path in the native renderer.

entries.id: src/composables/useTheme.test.ts#useTheme starts with the system theme ('light'), not a stale root theme#1

source.name: useTheme starts with the system theme ('light'), not a stale root theme

native.rationale: Actual native first-frame paint uses literal source light/dark background colors despite an opposite context override. Manual toggles survive unchanged OS observations and yield only to a real transition; both main and editor snapshots recolor deterministically. Dropping and recreating NativeApp restores the OS choice with no retained override: native theme observation is per-presenter input, not a global matchMedia listener capable of mutating a disposed instance. Unavailable preference normalization falls back to dark while manual toggling remains usable. The source apply helper tests deterministic state assignment, not a currently exposed direct-theme menu item; native raw theme events verify that assignment without adding obsolete menu commands. Actual OS notification delivery remains the separate platform gate.
